scope: Only ambiguous single-click Create vs Browse branch is held. Does not block notice/selection/hover/wire submission.

current.Browse: Single label click inspects details only. Plus/Add inserts at captured creation point; double-click and row drag remain existing creation routes.
current.Create: Single label click inspects details. Plus/Add or Enter selects a measured preview; canvas placement commits. Wired selection retains two-phase atomic create+connect.
current.plus: The existing explicit Add affordance chooses the candidate in Create and inserts in Browse; no button removed or redesigned.

canonical.behavior: 以graph座標記住建立點，搜尋重置，category路徑/source/type篩選；顯示標籤、來源badge及匹配port。wired模式列真正可規劃的連線變體，精確型別優先，每node顯示最佳變體；新source和已存在source有不同標示。
edgeCases: readonly不開；拖線遇不相容目標不改成Add。
來源CRUD／library內容由LC-DATA域描述，本項只描述選取入口。

canonical.trigger: port context Create候選，移cursor再左擊canvas
canonical.behavior: 先測量候選真實port與卡尺寸，顯示輪廓/預覽線，不實際加node/source。位置snap24；左擊有效canvas處一次提交節點+連線。Escape/Tab/右擊/外部點/換圖/版本變更取消。
edgeCases: singleton、dynamictyped節點使用preview投影，不可為測量偷改source。
拖面板位置與落點不同；確認後尾隨click被吞避免重複選取／連線。

canonical.trigger: 左側Add Node Categories/Library accordion；branch展開；點entry
canonical.behavior: 分類樹使用primary與secondarycategory（同一路徑去重），沿預定category/branch順序，再字串排序。branch展開狀態跨filter/render保留於會話；單擊只inspect signature/categorypath/help/aliases，不建立。subgraph列inputs/outputs而非假裝GLSL函數。
edgeCases: 只sourcefilter影響visibleentries，不改實際graph；Library可選all/project/personal/builtin並有獨立template區。
